Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh will feel they could have restricted New Zealand under 200. They had a really good chance when Tom Blundell and Henry Nicholls got out but they allowed the tail to wag a bit longer and now have a big task ahead. It was Mustafizur Rahman yet again who did the job. The spinners were not getting that much purchase but stuck to the plan. Mahedi Hasan ended with three while the debutant Khaled Ahmed got three too. Still, a pretty good bowling performance and it is now upto their batters to complete the job. They though have to bat well against the likes of Trent Boult and Kyle Jamieson. Stay tuned for the chase.

Excellent knock from Sodhi. His knock has helped New Zealand get past 250 and given them a good chance to win this game. Yet again, they didn't start well but h just like in the first match got things back on track along with Blundell. The former fell one short but the latter got to his fifty and got the Kiwis on a fine tune. It was Ish Sodhi's innings that made the big difference. Hasan Mahmud got him run out at the bowler's end but Bangladesh were happy enough to call him back on the pitch and it turned out to be a really crucial innings from him.

OUT! The final wicket is here. Khaled Ahmed was confident and the review helped them to get the wicket. Length ball, outside off. Sodhi looks to push but gets a faint edge to the keeper. Litton Das wasn't sure but Ahmed knew there was an edge. UltraEdge shows a spike as Bangladesh take the review. New Zealand end with 254.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. Slightly overcast conditions but for now we will start on time. Let's hope it stays the same. The players have made their way out in the middle. Finn Allen and Will Young to open for the Kiwis. One slip in place for Mustafizur Rahman. Let's play...
Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Litton Das (C/WK), Tamim Iqbal, Tanzid Hasan, Soumya Sarkar, Mahmudullah, Towhid Hridoy, Mahedi Hasan, Nasum Ahmed, Hasan Mahmud, Mustafizur Rahman, Khaled Ahmed.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Will Young, Chad Bowes, Henry Nicholls, Tom Blundell (WK), Rachin Ravindra, Cole McConchie, Ish Sodhi, Kyle Jamieson, Lockie Ferguson (C), Trent Boult.
Toss - New Zealand have won the toss and will bat first.

Hello and welcome to the second ODI between New Zealand and Bangladesh. The first match was washed out due to rain but the Kiwis will hope to put on a much better performance with the bat this time around. They lacked experience and it was seen in their batting. Bangladesh on the other hand made the most of the conditions. The Fizz was at his best and the spinners combined well to extract good amount of turn. However, the rain had the last say. The forecast looks the same for this game as well but let’s hope we atleast get a result from this match. Stay tuned.
